'''Ranklinge''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Shelsha sector/Legends|Shelsha sector]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

==Geography==
{{Quote|There's nothing on the southern continent?''"<br />"''Nothing but a civil war. Been going on for the past ten years.|[[Korlo Brightwater]] and [[Saberan Marcross]]|<ref name="Allegiance (novel)">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>}}
Its [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Ranklinge City]], had an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[Factory/Legends|plant]] on its outskirts that produced [[I-7 Howlrunner]]s at the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The main [[City/Legends|cities]], including the capital and [[Janusar]], were on the northern continent; the southern continent had been embroiled in a [[civil war]] since around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]].

==History==
The [[South Cont's civil war]] began in [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]]. After two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of war, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sent a couple of [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] in [[8 BBY/Legends|8 BBY]] to mediate the conflict. They didn't manage to solve the war and all Imperial forces eventually left the planet. The civil war was not ended in the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
